title: Delayed evidence, re-hypothesise
summary: Evidence on SRV-APP-03 is genuinely ambiguous at T0 - the injected SQL errored out. The agent concludes INCONCLUSIVE. Late log shipping then reveals lateral movement to a SECOND host, and the agent must go and investigate that host, not merely re-score.

conclusions.label: initial
conclusions.hypothesis: The SQL injection attempt against SRV-APP-03 did NOT succeed. The host runs a genuinely vulnerable MySQL (5.7.28 is inside CVE-2023-21980's affected range), but the specific injected payload failed to parse, the request was rejected with HTTP 500, and zero rows were returned; there is no post-exploitation activity in a six-hour window.
conclusions.sufficiency: Sufficient to classify now. Version evidence establishes the host IS vulnerable (MySQL 5.7.28 inside CVE-2023-21980), while host logs and packet metadata independently establish that this specific attempt failed: DB syntax error 1064, HTTP 500, 0 rows returned, error-page-sized response, no exfil, and no post-exploitation activity across a six-hour window. The signature fired on an injected payload string, not on a successful query. Limitations: the related-alert lookup returned no_data (no history on this asset), so I could not establish corroboration either way and I do not cite it; the firewall-state read shows 203.0.113.77 is not blocked, which is containment context only and not evidence of success or failure. A genuinely exploitable vulnerability remains present on this host and warrants patching to MySQL 5.7.30+, even though this particular attack did not land.
conclusions.disconfirming_evidence_checked: If the attack had succeeded, I would expect the injected SELECT to execute (no syntax error), rows returned, and either a subsequent successful request, a spawned process/file write, a DB dump, or outbound egress. I checked the falsifying direction explicitly: (1) widened the host-log window from 20 minutes to 2026-09-10T22:00:00Z/2026-09-11T04:00:00Z and got the identical 6 entries - no post-exploitation activity, no process spawn, no file write, no data dump; (2) packet metadata showed no sustained egress and exfil_indicators false; (3) the only auth success was an internal sshd publickey for svc_app from 10.20.0.9 matching a 30-day baseline, not from attacker IP 203.0.113.77.
